$description: Musy design system foundations. Two-layer: palette (raw, per mode) → semantic (aliases). Import palette.light + semantic.light as one Tokens Studio set and palette.dark + semantic.dark as the other; dimension/typography/motion/layout are mode-agnostic shared sets.

1.$description: App canvas — deepest surface in the theme

3.$description: Subtle surface — component background at rest

6.$description: Subtle border — separators, dividers, decorative outlines

9.$description: Solid fill — buttons, filled chips. A graphic that stands alone on a surface takes -edge, solved to 3:1 vs every surface (1.4.11)

press.$description: Solid fill — pressed; keeps the step-9 foreground legal

sand.$description: Linen neutral with a green-black ink

scrim.$description: Modal / sheet backdrop. Deeper in dark because the canvas is already dark.

shadow-key.$description: Tight contact shadow. Green-tinted in light so elevation reads as shade on linen, not grey.

surface.$description: Page background. The default canvas everything sits on.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, panels, popovers. Lighter than the page in BOTH themes — the paper-on-canvas model from the Figma screens.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells, track backgrounds, inset media. One level below the page.

surface-overlay.$description: Sheets, modals, menus. Same value as -raised; separated by elevation and scrim, not hue.

surface-inverse.$description: Tooltips, high-emphasis chips — deliberately opposite the theme.

on-surface.$description: Default body and heading text on any surface token.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, placeholder. Still a full 4.5:1 — never dips below the body threshold.

on-surface-disabled.$description: Text and icons in a disabled control. Exempt from 1.4.3; held near 3:1 anyway.

border-subtle.$description: Dividers and decorative outlines ONLY. Never permitted on an interactive boundary.

border-strong.$description: The only border allowed to carry a control boundary — solved to ≥3:1 (1.4.11). Green, not neutral: W2 names `border-ui` for the outline of an interactive element, so a control edge says "control" by hue as well as by contrast.

border-focus.$description: Focus indicator colour — green. ≥3:1 against every surface token in both themes.

interactive-primary.$description: Green solid fill — the family’s resting state, and THE DEFAULT for every interactive element.

interactive-primary-active.$description: Green solid fill while pressed. Solved so the SAME -on foreground still holds 4.5:1 — a plain step-11 swap would have put dark text on a dark fill.

interactive-primary-disabled.$description: Disabled fill — `green-soft`, so the state stays inside the family. The label and the cursor carry "unavailable", not the hue.

interactive-primary-on.$description: Foreground on the green solid — the PAGE colour, not the card colour ("auf Grün in BG-Farbe"). Theme-conditional: dark mode brightens the solid, so the foreground flips.

interactive-primary-on-disabled.$description: Foreground on a disabled fill — `muted`. Exempt from 1.4.3 — pair with a non-colour cue.

interactive-primary-subtle.$description: Green tinted fill — chips, tags, selected rows.

interactive-primary-on-subtle.$description: Text and icons on the green tinted fill, at any of its three states. INK, not a tinted green — green on green-soft measures 2.1:1.

interactive-primary-border.$description: Green boundary at ≥3:1. MANDATORY on any green fill that is not itself 3:1 against the surface.

interactive-accent.$description: Terracotta solid fill — the family’s resting state. OPT-IN ONLY: a screen asks for it, nothing defaults to it.

interactive-accent-active.$description: Terracotta solid fill while pressed. Solved so the SAME -on foreground still holds 4.5:1.

interactive-accent-disabled.$description: Disabled fill — neutral, so no family reads as available.

interactive-accent-on.$description: Foreground on the terracotta solid. The fill does not flip with the theme, so the ink over it must not either: both halves are the dark one of their own theme.

interactive-accent-on-disabled.$description: Foreground on a disabled fill. Exempt from 1.4.3 — pair with a non-colour cue.

interactive-accent-subtle.$description: Terracotta tinted fill — chips, tags, selected rows.

interactive-accent-on-subtle.$description: Text and icons on the terracotta tinted fill, at any of its three states.

interactive-accent-border.$description: Terracotta boundary at ≥3:1. MANDATORY on any terracotta fill that is not itself 3:1 against the surface.

interactive-ghost.$description: Ghost control at rest — no fill.

interactive-ghost-disabled.$description: Disabled ghost — still no fill; the label carries the state.

interactive-ghost-border.$description: Boundary for a ghost control that must still read as a control (outline button). Green: an outline button is the one ghost that has to read as an action.

accent-1.$description: Accent 1 (green) solid — category colour, chart series, avatar.

accent-2.$description: Accent 2 (terracotta) solid — category colour, chart series, avatar.

feedback-info-surface.$description: info banner / inline-message background. NEUTRAL: info is the one status that is not an outcome, so it is built on sand and recedes.

feedback-info-border.$description: info banner boundary at ≥3:1 — part of how status survives without colour (1.4.1).

feedback-info-icon.$description: info status icon. A meaningful graphic, so ≥3:1 required; lands at ≥4.5:1.

feedback-warning-border.$description: warning banner boundary at ≥3:1 — part of how status survives without colour (1.4.1).

feedback-warning-icon.$description: warning status icon. A meaningful graphic, so ≥3:1 required; lands at ≥4.5:1.

feedback-success-surface.$description: success banner background — grass, hue 99°, deliberately 52° off the brand green so status cannot be read as brand.

feedback-success-border.$description: success banner boundary at ≥3:1 — part of how status survives without colour (1.4.1).

feedback-success-icon.$description: success status icon. A meaningful graphic, so ≥3:1 required; lands at ≥4.5:1.

feedback-error-border.$description: error banner boundary at ≥3:1 — part of how status survives without colour (1.4.1).

feedback-error-icon.$description: error status icon. A meaningful graphic, so ≥3:1 required; lands at ≥4.5:1.

interactive-ghost-border-hover.$description: The same boundary on hover. Token gap G3: both raw references it replaced sit on a control whose hover FILL already comes from --interactive-ghost-hover, so the border follows its own family rather than borrowing the neutral one.

space-inset-control.$description: Inside a control → 44px min height at label-lg

space-gap-group.$description: Molecules that do not belong together

focus-ring-offset.$description: Gap renders in the parent surface

focus-ring-clearance.$description: Padding a focusable ancestor must keep so focus is never clipped (2.4.11)

display-xl.$description: Hero / launch headline. One per screen, ≤6 words. · 393px 40px / 834px 50.1px / 1440px 64px

heading-lg.$description: Primary screen headline — the Figma 26px step. · 393px 26px / 834px 29.4px / 1440px 34px

body-xl.$description: The largest body step, at display scale — an instruction the user reads and acts on, which asks rather than asserts. 500 not 600: the display face is loaded at 400/500/700, so a 600 would be synthesised. Same size, line and tracking as heading-lg; in CSS they are aliased so the two cannot drift. Pairs with on-surface-muted. Not a substitute for heading-lg on a screen title. · 393px 26px / 834px 29.4px / 1440px 34px

body-lg.$description: Guided-exercise prose — the reading size during a session. · 393px 19px / 834px 19.4px / 1440px 20px

body-md.$description: Default body. The MINIMUM body size in the system. · 393px 17px / 834px 17.4px / 1440px 18px

body-sm.$description: Metadata, timestamps, captions. NEVER essential prose. · 393px 15px / 834px 15.4px / 1440px 16px

bodyMinStep.$description: 17px at 393px. Steps below this are label/metadata only

reducedMotion.$value: all durations → 1ms, all travel → 0px, ease-emphasis → linear
reducedMotion.$description: Applied by media query in the CSS layer

gutter.$value: 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 px at base / md / lg / xl

1.$description: Card at rest. Dark mode adds the ring + surface-lightening

darkStrategy.$description: Both: --surface-raised steps up to sand-4 and --elevation-ring becomes sand-7
